info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Cancellation API facilitates the efficient cancellation of rides within a rideshare service. It enables service providers to manage customer ride cancellations seamlessly, ensuring updates are reflected in real-time. This API primarily interacts with rides associated with users who wish to cancel their ride requests. Typical consumers include rideshare application developers and fleet management systems. Use this endpoint to maintain current ride records and enhance user experience during ride management.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an existing ride by providing the necessary identifiers. Ensure that you have the appropriate permissions and that the ride is eligible for cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a ride. It requires the necessary information to identify the ride that needs to be canceled.

201.description: The ride cancelation request was processed successfully, and the ride has been canceled.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to cancel a ride.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.title: Ride Cancel Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result returned from the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the ride after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation status.

audit.description: Information about the auditing process related to the cancellation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.description: This schema represents the response returned after successfully canceling a ride.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that initiated the cancellation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the cancellation was processed.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was executed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: This schema contains details about the audit process after ride cancellation.

x-processing-time.description: The time in milliseconds it took to process the request.
